narrative:
Good morning, Ingrid. Here is Sport Holding as of last night's POS, web-shop and Business Central feeds.

**October close** is running at **WD+6**, five working days faster than September's WD+11, the first close on Business Central. The BC API timed out again on 2.1M journal lines, and this time the Data Lake fallback completed the GL feed automatically. 96.8% of records have landed and 93.8% are auto-matched; NOK 84.7M is still unmatched.

**Net sales** in the Q3 Forecast are **NOK 6,780M**, +4.0% on FY2025, but **NOK 130M below budget**. Gross margin is 36.1% against 36.7%.

**What moves the gap:**
• Stockouts: NOK 23.8M of gross margin lost YTD; ski stock in Trøndelag has 2.1 weeks of cover before week 50
• Promotions: the Anton Sport summer sale returned −NOK 4.1M margin ROI
• East shrink at 1.8% against a 1.1% budget

**Pending your decision:** the three Data Lake backfills, the ski re-allocation to Trondheim and the Black Friday depth cap.

signals.excerpt: September was the first close on Business Central: the BC API timed out under month-end volume and finance rebuilt the books from the Data Lake by hand over three days. October has 96.8% of records landed and 93.8% auto-matched on NOK 1,357M under close.

signals.title: BC API timeout on 2.1M journal lines — Data Lake fallback completed the feed
signals.source: SDP Close Control Tower — ingestion monitor, Business Central GL feed
signals.excerpt: The BC OData API timed out after 1.4M of 2.1M October journal lines. The ingestion agent switched to paged extraction from the Data Lake replica and checked the result against the BC trial balance — no manual workaround this month.

signals.title: Ski stock cover in Trøndelag at 2.1 weeks before the winter peak
signals.source: SDP Inventory & Stockout Intelligence — store stock × ML demand forecast
signals.excerpt: Intersport Trondheim City Syd and Solsiden have 2.1 weeks of alpine and cross-country cover against a 6-week target before week 50. Estimated sales at risk NOK 8.6M (NOK 3.2M gross margin) unless DC stock is re-allocated from Oslo this week.
